meta.navigationPath: Admin tab (#p-tabpanel-1-label) -> sidebar 'Agency' section (li:has-text("Agency") first match, expands submenu) -> sidebar 'Agency' sub-item (text=Agency, second match) -> /admin/agency (Search/List) -> 'Add agency' button -> /admin/agency/add

add.iataNumber: IATA Number field appears ONLY when iataYes is selected -- undocumented mandatory sub-field, not in Project Context/Test Design (discrepancy logged 2026-07-25)
add.ownerEmail: #id-EmailID (nth=0, duplicate id also used by Sales Contact email -- disambiguate by index)
add.uploadDocumentButton: button:has-text("Upload document") -- use page.waitForEvent('filechooser') + click, NOT input[type=file] indexing (multiple file inputs share the Documents/Logo sections ambiguously)
add.productAccessSection: renders/populates ONLY after a Branch is selected (inherits Supplier/Product config from that Branch) -- contradicts an earlier blank-branch snapshot that showed it absent
add.productAccessTable: table (STATUS/SUPPLIER NAME/CREDENTIAL NAME/PRODUCT NAME/DESCRIPTION columns, appears once a product checkbox is checked)
add.pccSection: Airline Supplier Credential (PCC) -- also renders only after Branch selected; genericSupplierCredential dropdown, Manager Name (appears disabled/auto-inherited), Supplier Credentials Description
add.notes: No 'Save as Draft' button exists on the live form (TC-AGENCY-CREATE-035 precondition unmet -- Blocked, discrepancy for Test Design). Documents and Sales Contact sections' own 'Add' buttons append a SECOND EMPTY required row -- do not click unless intentionally adding a 2nd entry (matches Automation Decision Report CREATE-015/020 quirk, generalizes to Sales Contact). Contract Start/End Date and other PrimeNG calendar inputs require page.click() + page.keyboard.type() -- page.fill() does not register with Angular's value accessor. PrimeNG p-dropdown inputs are zero-size proxies -- click the wrapping 'div.p-dropdown:has(#id)' element, not the input itself. Credit Limit/Top-up Limit/Credit Terms(Days) show non-empty backend defaults (50000/500000/1) even on a blank Add form. Agency Name uniqueness is enforced server-side ('Agency Name is already exists').
